svg.title: Sequence — Tactic card effects (Traitor, then the two-step Recruiter)

g.text: Sequence — Tactic card effects (Traitor, then the two-step Recruiter)
A. Traitor: a one-step effect with two board choices
Traitor appears on the discard pile)
play the Recruiter, choose the decks (dialog)
put the cards under their decks
The engine never names a card: adding a Tactic or an expansion card
means registering a new CardEffect (or MultiStepEffect) in the registry.
